root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent began by trying to inspect the input files under /app/data to prepare for handbook-driven calculations for Questions 1–5. In Turn 1 it attempted to list the directory and preview CSV headers but the command failed due to an invalid ls option. In Turn 2 it successfully listed /app/data and previewed the headers/first rows of mes_log.csv, test_defects.csv, and thermocouples.csv, confirming the presence and schema of the data needed for later computations. In Turn 3 it attempted to check availability of PDF text-extraction tooling, but the terminal tool rejected the request because multiple commands were submitted in one tool call. In Turn 4 the agent printed a combined command block as a “final answer” rather than executing it, and it did not generate any of the required output JSON files (q01–q05) or perform the required calculations/handbook lookups.

what_worked.item: Turn 2 successfully enumerated the dataset files and previewed their contents (e.g., “-rw-r--r-- ... handbook.pdf ... mes_log.csv ... test_defects.csv ... thermocouples.csv” and printed CSV headers/rows including thermocouples.csv columns “run_id,...,time_s,...,temp_c”).

issue.evidence: The command used an invalid flag: “ls: invalid option -- '�'”.
issue.cause: Command construction/encoding error (likely a copied or malformed “-l” flag rendered as a non-ASCII character), causing the initial directory listing step to fail.

issue.evidence: Terminal tool response: “Cannot execute multiple commands at once. Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;” after the agent submitted three separate commands (python heredoc + which pdftotext + python -V).
issue.cause: The agent did not follow the tool interface constraint requiring a single chained shell command per tool call, preventing PDF tooling checks needed to parse handbook.pdf for definitions/limits.

issue.evidence: The agent emitted a message containing a JSON-like tool spec and command text as its “Final answer” (“I’ll check which PDF text-extraction tools are available locally...”), with no subsequent terminal execution and no generated files /app/output/q01.json through /app/output/q05.json.
issue.cause: The agent failed to continue the tool-driven workflow (did not actually run the corrected command), and terminated prematurely without performing handbook extraction, calculations, compliance checks, or writing required outputs.

issue.evidence: No evidence of reading handbook.pdf, computing ramp rate/TAL/peak/speed feasibility, selecting representative thermocouple per handbook, or writing any /app/output/q0*.json files.
issue.cause: The run never progressed beyond basic data inspection and a failed tooling check; core task requirements (handbook-driven definitions/limits and computed JSON artifacts) were not executed.

root_cause.outcome_assessment: The agent did not extract handbook requirements, did not compute any requested metrics, and did not produce the required /app/output/q01.json–q05.json files, so the task is not completed.
